in_marathi.name: Parshu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ax wielder, warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Parshu is the name of the divine ax wielded by Lord Shiva, the god of destruction. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'parsha', meaning 'to divide'. Parshu represents strength, power, and destruction, and is often used as a symbol of transformation and renewal in Hinduism.
